While Top 25% improved substantially (+5.48%), underdog performance is the top priority and this degradation is unacceptable. tradeoffs: Removing constraints (even stale ones set to 0) changed model behavior significantly, boosting high-confidence predictions but catastrophically harming underdog performance. The tradeoff is unacceptable given underdog priority.

lessons_learned: Even 'stale' constraints set to 0 influence model behavior. Removing them allows more flexible learning on those features, which can harm underdog calibration. Future iterations should use regularization hyperparameters rather than constraint manipulation.
